text:
alice_support: forwarding customer report — they say embeddings shape changed after we switched their account to reserved capacity and pinned rwd-open-embed-v2. their ingestion jobs started failing with shape errors. pasted logs below.

alice_support: customer snippet: <paste>
Error: embedding vector length mismatch: expected 1536, got 1024
Request-ID: req_0a9c3f
Model: rwd-open-embed-v2 (pinned)
Batch size: 128

alice_support: re: customer says this started immediately after they accepted the reserved capacity switch (no other changes on their side). they also included a curl they used.

ryan_eng: can you share the exact request payload and the model name in the Authorization header? also which quantization/variant we routed to?

alice_support: curl snippet they sent: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-cust-XXXX' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rwd-open-embed-v2","input":["doc1","doc2"],"batch_size":128}'
```
They also attached their client lib error: `ValueError: expected embedding length 1536 but got 1024`

ryan_eng: hmm. rwd-open-embed-v2 should return 1536 for that family. possible causes: model flavor swapped to a 1024-wide variant during canary/fallback OR server-side model signature changed when we applied a reserved deploy that mapped to a different artifact. @deploy-bot can you confirm any model aliasing/variant fallback events for that customer?

deploy-bot: [automated] 3234567800 — applied reserve-switch for acct_acme -> routing policy: reserved-pool-us-east-1; pinned model alias rwd-open-embed-v2 -> resolved to artifact id: embed-v2-1024-2026-03-15 (note: staged fallback variant)

chun_ops: whoa — that artifact id shows 1024 in the name. looks like during the reserved pool mapping we accidentally aliased the v2 name to a 1024-quant variant. bad.

sam_platform: steps: 1) revert alias rwd-open-embed-v2 -> embed-v2-1536-2026-02-10 2) notify affected accounts 3) force-invalidate prefix cache for embeddings on reserved nodes 4) run small repro with customer's request-id.

ryan_eng: agree. also need to check migration script that created the alias during reserve-switch. add a guard: artifact metadata must include vector_dim match model catalog entry.

alice_support: responding to customer: apologizing, saying we identified alias mismatch and will revert routing; ETA ~20min, will follow up with root cause. customer asked about data corruption in their index — they snapshot and then re-ingest after we revert.

chun_ops: I pushed alias revert to canary now (non-prod). running a quick embed call: ```python
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="rwd-open-embed-v2", input=["x"])
print(len(resp.data[0].embedding))
```
returns 1536 on canary.

chun_ops: scheduling reserved-node rollout revert in 5m. once rolled back we should confirm customer's failed ingestion jobs can be retried safely. recommend advising them to re-ingest to be safe — vector lengths inconsistent in their index may break downstream.

alice_support: sending update to customer now. will include repro steps and our mitigation. :white_check_mark: 

sam_platform: follow-up action items: ticket -> ENG-INC-953, add preflight check on alias -> artifact dimension equality, add alert when embedding-dim mismatch errors >3/min per-account, add migration test for reserve-switch.

alice_support: closing loop later with postmortem and timeline. thanks all.
